name: The Jammed Mill
theme: A small kindness that the whole village notices.

stages.title: The Silent Waterwheel
stages.description: A riverside village mill stands quiet, its great wheel jammed and dripping. The miller waves you over, anxious.

nodes.speaker: Miller Bramwell
nodes.text: Wheel's jammed solid and something's nesting in the sluice. No wheel, no flour -- and the harvest fair is in three days. Could you take a look?

choices.label: I'll take a look at your wheel.
[Persuasion] Breathe -- you'll have flour by the fair.

nodes.speaker: Miller Bramwell
nodes.text: Bless you -- first easy breath I've drawn all week. The sluice gate is round the side.

nodes.speaker: Miller Bramwell
nodes.text: Thank you. The sluice gate is round the side -- mind your footing, it's slick.

stages.title: The Sluice Gate
stages.description: Cold water sheets over a tangle of driftwood -- and a nest of corrupted river-vermin bristles in the gap.

objectives.description: Clear whatever is jamming the wheel.

steps.prompt: You study the jam and the nesting vermin.

on_success.text: You spot it: one keystone log holds the whole tangle. Pull it right and the rest floats free -- no need to provoke the nest.

on_failure.text: The tangle is dense and the vermin are agitated; it will take some doing.

steps.prompt: How do you clear the sluice?

options.label: Coax the vermin out and pull the keystone log free (no fight).
Drive the corrupted vermin off by force.

stages.title: A Gentle Hand
stages.description: You work the tangle loose without a fight.

steps.prompt: You coax the skittish vermin toward the far bank.

on_success.text: The vermin scatter downstream. You lever the keystone log free and the wheel shudders back to life.

on_failure.text: It takes patience and a soaked sleeve, but the nest empties and the log comes free. The wheel turns.

stages.title: Driving Them Off
stages.description: The corrupted vermin will not be reasoned with.

waves.name: The nest boils out of the sluice

steps.text: With the nest scattered, you lever the keystone log free and the wheel grinds back into motion.

stages.title: A Fair Wage
stages.description: The wheel turns, the grindstone hums, and Miller Bramwell presses a small pouch of silver into your hand.

steps.prompt: The miller offers you silver he can barely spare. Do you take it?

options.label: Wave it off -- put it toward the harvest fair.
